module_summary: Ethernet frame N-to-1 multiplexer under external select/enable: a frame flag latches the selected source index and header per frame, and a select-indexed mux feeds payload into a skid-buffered AXI-Stream output.

anchors.name: frame_reg
anchors.why: Frame-in-progress state: set on header accept, cleared on last payload beat; blocks reselection.

anchors.name: select_reg
anchors.why: Source index latched at frame start; selects payload lanes for the whole frame.

anchors.name: select
anchors.why: External source selection input sampled at frame start; picks header fields.

anchors.name: enable
anchors.why: External enable permitting a new frame to start.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Per-source header valid; selected bit triggers frame start.

anchors.name: s_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Header ready pulsed to selected source on frame start.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_valid
anchors.why: Output header valid registered at frame start, held until ready.

anchors.name: m_eth_hdr_ready
anchors.why: Downstream header ready clearing header valid.

anchors.name: m_eth_dest_mac
anchors.why: Output header fields (dest/src MAC, type) latched from the selected source.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Concatenated per-source payload data muxed by select_reg.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Per-source payload valid; selected bit forms current beat valid.

anchors.name: s_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Registered payload ready asserted only on selected source during frame.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tdata
anchors.why: Output payload data from registered output slice.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tvalid
anchors.why: Output payload valid from output register.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready
anchors.why: Downstream payload ready deciding output/temp register transfers.

anchors.name: m_eth_payload_axis_tready_int_reg
anchors.why: Registered internal ready gating acceptance into output skid buffer.

anchors.name: temp_m_eth_payload_axis_tdata_reg
anchors.why: Skid buffer data register holding a beat when output stalls.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable copying internal payload into output registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_int_to_temp
anchors.why: Load enable capturing internal payload into temp registers.

anchors.name: store_axis_temp_to_output
anchors.why: Load enable moving temp contents to output registers.

groups.name: Frame and select control
groups.description: Starts a frame on enable and selected header valid, latches select and header fields.

groups.name: Payload mux
groups.description: Selects payload lanes of latched source and generates its tready.

groups.name: Output skid buffer
groups.description: Output plus temp registers implementing registered AXI-Stream skid buffer.
